editorial.description_en: Mist filling a valley in the morning, taking a little green from what it is sitting on.
editorial.description_ja: 谷にたまった霧のような、緑がかったうすい色。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.836, C 0.022, h 158.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 谷 (tani, valley) + 霧 (kiri, mist), rendaku to -giri. It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Valley Mist" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 谷霧. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — iwa-shimizu at ΔE00 4.3, usu-shiba at ΔE00 5.3, shimo-ba at ΔE00 5.4. complementary is empty because at chroma 0.022 the hue is not a reliable enough statement to oppose. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
